correctness.rationale: PASS. For every q>=2 the target words are exactly abab for all a,b in a labeled alphabet. In a cyclic list of distinct targets the suffix-prefix overlap between different targets has shifts 1,3 or 4 (never 2). A shift-1 transition uses one opposite ordered pair {abab,baba}; there can be at most binom(q,2) in the one connected tour. Contract chosen pairs; unmatched pairs and shift-4 transitions must connect all q symbol states, so 2s+z>=q. The cost bound then gives 2q(q+1). Grouped order aaaa,(abab,baba) for b>a achieves exact count of shift-1,3,4 transitions and a single cyclic witness. Independently implemented subset Held–Karp Hamiltonian-tour DP gave 12,24,40 at q=2,3,4. Finite DP corroborates, but arbitrary-q connectivity proof is the main certificate.
